For the friend who sits up straight, then slowly melts.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left. A speech bubble says posture! and it stretches tall with wide eyes, then happy eyes and a small pulse. Slowly it sags and tilts to one side with sleepy eyes. The bubble says posture! again, it snaps tall again, and then it slowly melts to the other side before settling back upright exactly where it started, so the film can repeat without a cut. The text stays: me fixing my posture again.
